name: Heirloom Weapon
label: Quest
description: Heirloom Weapon: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I will keep three of the weapons you returned to me, as mementos of my pain and loss. But please, friend, choose your favorite of the heirlooms and keep it for yourself.
May it serve you greater than it served its cursed, former owners.
